title: Japan 5-Year JGB auction (¥2,500bn anticipated, maturity 2031-09-20) — the matched control that refutes the supply channel and shows the family's ≥2bp tail metric is duration-biased
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (english/policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,187 bytes) for this initial research; parsed cell by cell, its table row reads 'Nov. 12, 2026 | 5-year' with no issue number and no 'Auction Announcement' href. The DATE is MOF's own. NO SIZE IS ASSERTED: `2612e.htm` 404s and MOF's note reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date'. ¥2,500bn is the anticipated base case from TWO MOF announcement pages read directly this session — announcement/auct20260810e.htm and auct20260901e.htm (both HTTP 200, fetched 2026-09-09) each read 'About 2,500 billion yen' for the 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-08 auctions, as does auct20260702e.htm for 2026-07-09 — and from the Auction Results for JGBs workbook (english/policy/jgbs/auction/past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, 492,032 bytes, last saved 2026-08-13, parsed 2026-09-09), whose 5年債 sheet shows ¥2,500bn at 2024-01-16, ¥2,300bn from 2024-04-09, ¥2,400bn from 2025-04-10 and ¥2,500bn from 2026-01-14 — a round trip, net ±0.0% endpoint to endpoint over an −8.0% trough, NOT a flat line. THE ANNOUNCEMENT DATE IS A MEASURED RULE WITH ITS EXCEPTION MECHANISM IDENTIFIED, which is a sharper reading than the 10-year sibling's 'exactly seven days, 3 of 3': across all NINE 5-year auctions of 2026 the lead is seven calendar days in eight of nine (01-07→01-14, 02-10→02-17, 03-04→03-11, 04-02→04-09, 05-11→05-18, 06-16→06-23, 07-02→07-09, 09-01→09-08), and the single eight-day case (08-10→08-18) is explained without exception-pleading — 2026-08-11 is Mountain Day, so the seven-day slot fell on a holiday and the announcement moved back one business day. That puts the 2026-11-12 terms on 2026-11-05, itself a business day and the same date as the 10-year auction. THE ISSUE NUMBER IS DELIBERATELY NOT PREDICTED, AND THAT IS A FINDING RATHER THAN A GAP: the 10-year's fixed rotation (32 of 34 completed issues run exactly three auctions; every maturity date carries exactly one issue) DOES NOT GENERALISE HERE. Across the 103 5-year auctions from 2018-01, completed issues run 1, 2, 3 and 4 auctions (24 / 9 / 19 / 1), nine maturity dates carry two issue numbers and five carry three, and 53 of 104 auction-to-auction transitions opened a new number against 51 reopenings — MOF re-sets the coupon by opening a fresh issue at the SAME maturity 19 times in that window. The best single-threshold rule on the yield-minus-running-coupon gap calls it correctly only 71.2% of the time. WHAT IS PREDICTABLE IS THE MATURITY: the 5-year matures on the 20th of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec in 103 of 103 auctions, and each auction quarter maps to exactly one maturity date in 34 of 35 quarters (the sole exception is 2018Q1, the window's own first — the same shape as the 10-year's issue-350 exception). 2026Q3 carried 2031-06-20, so 2026Q4 — and therefore 2026-11-12 — carries 2031-09-20. Filed `estimate` on the two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Proposed 2026-09-09 by the jgb-10y-auction-2026-11-05 sweep as 'the sharpest control that exists for the 10-year' — same-month, near-identical BoJ dose (3-5y −62.3% vs 5-10y −64.8%), issuance moved less (±0.0% vs −3.7%) — to separate 'the 10-year is damaged because its bucket was tapered' from 'the 10-year is damaged because it carries ten years of duration'. THE CONTROL WORKED, AND IT REFUTES BOTH SIDES OF THAT FORK PLUS ONE CLAIM THE PROPOSING LEDGER CALLED ITS OWN DURABLE FINDING. (1) THE SUPPLY CHANNEL DIES ON A MATCHED PAIR. Netting MOF issuance against BoJ purchases from the same 32 monthly operation workbooks (ope2401→ope2608, all HTTP 200, parsed 2026-09-09), net supply to private hands in the 3-5y bucket ran ¥798.6bn/month in 2024-01 and ¥1,859.0bn in 2026-08: +132.8%. The 10-year's own figures are ¥797.3bn → ¥1,929.3bn, +142.0%. The two starting levels sit ¥1.3bn/month — 0.16% — apart, and the two shocks are 9 percentage points apart, yet the 5-year has printed ZERO tails at or beyond 2bp across 33 auctions since 2024 (max 1.5bp) against the 10-year's 19.4%. A near-identical supply shock at a near-identical base produced opposite auction outcomes; net supply does not explain auction quality. (2) THE PROPOSING LEDGER'S 'ONLY TENOR WHERE NET SUPPLY ROSE' IS FALSE AS STATED, because it computed three of the BoJ's six buckets. Across all of them the 1-3y bucket (2-year) rose +49.4% and the 3-5y bucket rose +132.8% alongside the 5-10y's +142.0%, against 10-25y −9.1% and 25y+ −45.5%. Three tenors rose, not one. (3) THE 'DETERIORATION SPLITS AT TEN YEARS' DURATION' CONCLUSION IS A METRIC ARTIFACT. A ≥2bp tail is a fixed YIELD threshold applied to tenors whose tails scale with duration: 2bp is 3.3× the 2-year's own 2007-2023 p90, 2.6× the 5-year's, and only 1.25× the 30-year's. Re-run scale-free — the share of 2024+ auctions above each tenor's OWN pre-2024 p90 — deterioration is universal and statistically indistinguishable: 2Y 32.3% (10/31), 5Y 39.4% (13/33), 10Y 32.3% (10/31), 20Y 38.7% (12/31), 30Y 25.8% (8/31), every one of them z ≥ +2.93 against the 10% a stationary distribution implies, and the widest gap on the board (5Y vs 30Y) is z = +1.16, not significant. On this metric the 5-year is the WORST tenor on the curve, not the cleanest. (4) THE MUNDANE ALTERNATIVE THE PROPOSING LEDGER NAMED BUT DID NOT TEST — 'tails scale with duration × yield volatility' — IS ALSO REFUTED as a proportional explanation. Daily par-yield volatility rose by almost exactly the same factor at every tenor (2Y 1.80×, 5Y 1.53×, 10Y 1.55×, 20Y 1.60×, 30Y 1.53×) while tail means rose 1.75× to 2.35×, and the two are uncorrelated across the curve (−0.355, n=5). NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is low for the reasons every sibling JGB ledger records: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
